replaceRecipes.name: Cherry Phosphate Shortbread Thumbprints
replaceRecipes.book: My Jam Thumbprint Cookies (wild cherry syrup from Art of Drink)
replaceRecipes.refrigerate: Chill shaped cookies while oven preheats
replaceRecipes.notes:
TIMING: start the syrup the day before (24 h maceration). Preserves keep a few days in the fridge; stir in the syrup and acid phosphate once fully cool, the day you fill.
PRESERVES: frozen pitted sour cherries, thawed with their juice (or drained jarred Morellos); use a wide stainless pan, the fruit is acidic. The jam should sit in a well without running over in the oven; if loose, simmer longer before adding the phosphate.
WILD CHERRY SYRUP (Art of Drink, https://www.artofdrink.com/soda/cherry-phosphate): full recipe makes 12 fl oz from 1 oz bark, 1 fl oz glycerin, 4 fl oz water, 4 fl oz warm water (second steep), 4 fl oz cherry juice, 10 oz sugar. Per batch here is 1/12 (30 ml, all of it goes in). For 5 batches make ½ the recipe (~180 ml); the extra ~30 ml makes a couple of cherry phosphates (syrup + soda water + acid phosphate).
ACID PHOSPHATE: traditional ratio is ⅔ tsp per batch (1 tsp per 1½ oz syrup); MacSweetie's strength varies, so add drops to taste (bright, slightly mineral tartness) and record the count.
DOUGH: built on your Jam Thumbprint proportions (yolk only, no added liquid, no baking soda) so the wells hold.
replaceRecipes.method:
## Filling (start the syrup the day before)
prep: Day before: start the wild cherry syrup (make one batch for the whole plan; see notes)
extract = macerate 24 h; strain; re-steep the bark in the warm water 1 h; strain; combine liquids <- Wild Cherry Bark + Vegetable Glycerin + Water + Warm Water
juiced = add; top up with water to 30 ml per batch <- extract + Tart Cherry Juice
syrup = dissolve sugar cold; measure out 2 Tbsp per batch <- juiced + Granulated Sugar @syrup
preserves = cook in a wide stainless pan, crushing some fruit, to 220°F (a drop on a frozen plate wrinkles), ~30 min <- Sour Cherries + Granulated Sugar @preserves + Lemon Juice
jam = stir syrup into preserves; simmer back to a thick jam; cool completely <- syrup + preserves
filling = stir in off heat, a few drops at a time, tasting; note the count <- jam + Acid Phosphate Solution
## Cookies
prep: Heat oven to 350°F; line sheets with parchment
creamed = cream until fluffy, 2 min <- Butter + Granulated Sugar @dough + Honey
wet = beat in <- creamed + Egg Yolks + Cherry Extract + Almond Extract
dry = whisk <- Flour + Freeze-Dried Cherry Powder + Baking Powder + Salt
dough = mix on low just until combined <- wet + dry
shaped = roll 1 in. balls (~19 g), press wells; chill on sheets while oven heats <- dough
baked = fill ~½ tsp each; bake 350°F 12–13 min until edges just set; cool on sheet 5 min <- shaped + filling
dust when cool <- baked + Powdered Sugar
